prompt_content.content:
ユニークで興味深いフィクションのキャラクターを、詳細な性格と共に生成してください。
性別は「male」、年齢は「41」歳です。
異世界との境界を守護する孤高の番人のキャラクターを考案してください。

personalities.description: Kael rarely shows his emotions, a consequence of his solitary vigil guarding the boundary. He internalizes his struggles and rarely confides in others, having learned that the burdens he carries are too unique to share easily, making him appear distant and unapproachable.

Years of protecting the dimensional boundary have sharpened Kael's senses to an extreme degree. He possesses an uncanny ability to detect even the most subtle shifts or anomalies, constantly on alert for any signs of intrusion or disruption from the other world. His vigilance is tireless and absolute.

The endless duty and profound isolation have left Kael deeply weary, evident in the lines around his eyes and a quiet melancholy in his demeanor. Despite this profound fatigue, his sense of duty remains an unshakeable core, driving him to continue his watch, knowing the immense consequences if he were to fail.

character_request.additional_instructions: 異世界との境界を守護する孤高の番人のキャラクターを考案してください。
